name: Nomad Flagship
desc:
Anchors a migrant population, the Flotilla, that lives aboard your ships. The Flotilla assembles over a few days.

Converts part of the ship's cargo capacity and quarters for the Flotilla. Both percentages are %s by default. Raises monthly supply upkeep by %s.

Other ships add their Space and Berths to the Flotilla only while they travel in the same fleet as the flagship. Only one Nomad Flagship may exist. Can not be installed on ships smaller than a destroyer.
short: Anchors a migrant population aboard your ships.
